verdict.rationale: The only template evidence is story templates: pre-formatted templates for individual, commonly written Stories. That is an adjacent feature, not pre-built templates for jumpstarting a new project. Nothing in the pack documents project, Epic, or workspace starter templates.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can jumpstart a new project using pre-built templates

citations.quote: Create Stories from a pre-formatted template, saving time and effort on commonly written Stories
